what: IB realizedPNL reads 0.0 on closing fills (root cause of SA-AUD-3 ib_execution zero-pnl rows, FIX-SA-04 #14172 only demotes the symptom). Read from ib_insync 0.9.86 source, NOT confirmed on the live raw store: Fill is built with a default CommissionReport() (realizedPNL=0.0, execId=''), and wrapper.commissionReport coerces IB's UNSET_DOUBLE to 0.0 before src/runtime/exchange_fills_ib.py::ib_fill_to_row's `abs(realized) > 1e17` sentinel check can see it (that check is dead for ib_insync). So 0.0 means 'no commission report yet' or 'not applicable', not break-even. Proposed fix (Tier-2, runtime mapper): in ib_fill_to_row treat a report with empty execId as absent (realized=None) so fills_pnl.exit_from_fills(require_realized=True) returns None and the resolver falls back instead of stamping ib_execution with 0.0.
